thread:
Jordan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: pricing, quotas, and credits. A few real customer asks we should decide on messaging for: 1) Can promo credits be reissued if used accidentally? 2) Are rate limits scoped to org or per-API-key by default? 3) What's the default trial behavior for bursty traffic?

Leah: Short version: promo credits are time-limited and non-transferable; we can do one-off reissues case-by-case but not guaranteed. Rate limits default to org-level but we support per-key caps. Trials should default to full consumption (so customers see real costs) but offer a "managed trial" option that throttles. We'll publish guidance.

Marcus: Legal note: any exceptions to promo expirations need a record and approval. We should avoid automated refunds without manual review (audit trail requirement).

Ivy: Support note: customers keep asking for auto-pause. We should offer a console toggle "Soft caps (managed trial)" that issues warnings and then throttles at a threshold. Also add a canned response template for extension requests.

Tariq: SRE/infra: we already expose headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Adding `X-Quota-Mode: soft|hard` is simple. We can implement managed-trial by switching to 429+Retry-After once soft threshold reached. Example response:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Quota-Mode: soft
Retry-After: 60

billing-bot: Billing policy updated (staging) 2025-08-18T11:02Z: promo_credit.expiry visible in console; support extension flag created (requires finance approval).

Jordan: Action items: 1) Product to draft short FAQ & Console copy for managed trials (Jordan) 2) Legal to write the approval flow for extensions (Marcus) 3) SRE to add `X-Quota-Mode` header and webhook event `quota.threshold` (Tariq) 4) Support to add canned reply + checklist (Ivy). Aim to have PRs by Wednesday.

Leah: Good plan. Make sure the FAQ explains: default org-level limits, per-key caps opt-in, and that promo credits show expiry date. Also include escalation contacts.

Ivy: I'll draft the canned response and link it here when ready.

Jordan: I'll post the FAQ draft and Console screenshots in #product by Tues EOD. Thanks all! :rocket:
